 JUDGMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the PSI of City Market police Station, Bengaluru against the accused No.1 & 2 for the offences punishable U/sec.63 of Copy Right Act and Sec. 420 of IPC.
02.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is that, on 23.09.2021 at about 5 pm within the limits of City Market Police Station, situated at Chikkapete Main Road, 'Heera Times' and 'MP Marketing shops', the accused were selling of spurious / counterfeit reputed company watches i.e., FOSSIL without obtaining any permission from the reputed company and were cheated to the public and CW.1's company and thus the accused have committed the above said offences.
03.
After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offences punishable U/sec. 63 of Copy Right Act and sec. 420 of IPC and issued summons to the accused No.1 & 2.
Accordingly the accused persons appeared before the court through their counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on,
charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused persons under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.

As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused persons, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to them, but they denied the contents of charge and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.
05. In furtherance of the charges leveled against the accused, the following points are arisen for my consideration.

sentences.text:
Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on 23.09.2021 at about 5 pm within the limits of City Market Police Station, situated at Chikkapete Main Road, 'Heera Times' and 'MP Marketing shops', the accused were selling of spurious / counterfeit reputed company watches i.e., FOSSIL without obtaining any permission from the reputed company and were cheated to the public and CW.1's company and thereby the accused has committed the offences punishable U/sec.63 of Copy Right Act and sec.420 of IPC.?
2.
What order or sentence?
06. To prove the case, the prosecution has examined in all 6 witnesses i.e., CW.5, 7, 1, 2, 4 & 6 as PW.1 to 6 and got marked 4 documents as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.4 and also marked watches as MO.1.
The prosecution has also not secured the presence of CW.3 and his evidence is also dropped.

07. After completion of evidence of prosecution, the incriminating circumstances in the evidence of the prosecution is read over to the accused NO.1 & 2 and statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C.
recorded.
The accused have denied the incriminating circumstances as false and not chosen to lead their defence evidence.
08. Heard the arguments.
My findings on the above said points are as follows:-
Point No.1 : In the negative.

Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 09.
Point No.1:
To prove the case, the prosecution has examined six witnesses.
CW.5, 4, & 6 are examined as PW.1, 5 & 6 respectively.

They categorically deposed that, on 23.09.2021 CW.7/ PW.2 called them and informed about the complaint given by CW.1/ PW.3 and given oral direction to co-operate to conduct the raid on Maruthi Plaza and Times Shops situated at Chikkapete,
Bengaluru.
The CW.1 / PW.3 verified the duplicate goods stored in the shop.
He has found 15 duplicate watches, CW.7/ PW.2 conducted the panchanama and seized them.
Thereby, they supported the case of prosecution.

10. Further, CW.1 examined as PW.3, who being the complainant has deposed that, the owners of the 'Heera Time Centre' and 'MP Marketing shops' were stored duplicate watches by using reputed brands logo i.e., ' FOSSIL', ' MK DEGIL' and ' ARMANI' and selling the same to the public at large for their illegal gain.
The police have seized said duplicate watches on 23.09.2021 in between 7.15 to 8.45 pm., on 13.10.2021, he returned the 13 watches of ' Heera Company' and 15 watches ' MP Marketing' to the police.
He identified the original report and supported the case of prosecution.

CW.2 is examined as PW.4, who being the panch witness has deposed about seizure of duplicate watches from 'MP Marketing' and ' Heera Times' on 23.09.2021 and deposed about conducting of panchanama as per Ex.P.3 in his presence and identified the Ex.P.3 panchanama and MO.1 watches,
thereby he supported the case of prosecution.
12.

Further, CW.7 is examined as PW.2, who being the Investigation Officer has deposed about receiving of complaint on 23.09.2021 at 6.45 p.m., given by CW.1, registering the FIR conducting the panchanama, seizure of the goods, receiving of the original report, releasing of accused on bail and submitting of PF and recording the statement of CW.2 to 6 and deposed about submitting of final report.
Thereby, he too supported the case of prosecution.
13. After careful perusal of Ex.P.2 i.e., complaint lodged by CW.1 / PW.3 which is the computer typed complaint.

Wherein, the Police Station address and the alleged shops names i.e., ' Heera Time Centre' and ' MP Marketing' was written by hand, which prima-facie goes to show that, the complainant filed the pre- determined complaint by keeping ready format with him and only inserting the names of the shops, which creates doubt about the case of prosecution.

That apart, all the witnesses including the complainant have deposed that, the accused persons selling the duplicate watches of ' FOSSIL', ' MK DEGIL' and ' ARMANI' etc., but in Ex.P.1 no such named watches were found.

15. Point No.3:- In view of the findings recorded to the above points, this court proceed to pass the following:-
ORDER

By exercising powers conferred U/sec. 248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused No.1 &
2 are acquitted for the offences punishable U/sec. 63 of Copy Right Act and sec. 420 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond of the accused No.1 & 2 shall continue in force for a period of 6 months.
The accused No.1 & 2 are set at liberty.
The property reported in PF No.106/2021 marked as MO.1 being watches are ordered to be destroyed as worthless after appeal period is over.
